title: Correct pressure magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 15 N, derived from the centripetal force equation at point B.

title: Correct total time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 2/3 s, derived from the two-stage motion analysis.

title: Centripetal force application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law in radial form (N - mg = mv₀²/R) at point B.

title: Two-stage motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must identify the two distinct phases: relative sliding until velocities equal, and subsequent joint deceleration.

title: Correct friction forces
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate f₁ = μ₁mg (2.5 N) and f₂ = μ₂(m+M)g (1.5 N).

title: Velocity at B
description: Important: The solution must correctly determine the speed at B using energy conservation: v₀ = √(2gR) = 2 m/s.

title: Acceleration calculations
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly show the individual accelerations a₁ = -5 m/s² and a₂ = 1 m/s² during sliding.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution may demonstrate consistent use of SI units (m, kg, s, N) throughout.

title: Sign error in accelerations
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of acceleration (especially for the sliding phase) is incorrectly assigned, leading to wrong kinematics.

title: Forgetting normal force at B
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution omits the object's weight when calculating the normal force/pressure at point B.
